table.$description: Data table for dense list/console surfaces — the Staff Message Center threads console is its driving use case. A container (surface + hairline border + radius, the same 'separate with a border, not a shadow' convention as Card) wrapping a header row and body rows; cells are laid out by the consumer (grid/flex columns), the component owns the header/row/cell recipe and the row states. Rows can be interactive (a whole-row link/button) with hover/selected states, and carry an unread/read weight pair for inbox-style lists (unread = semibold ink, read = normal secondary) — the exact pair ThreadListItem's own inbox rows already use, reused here rather than re-derived. Header labels reuse text-style.label-sm (uppercase, wide tracking) — the same small-caps column-header treatment already used across the docs legends. No fixed column model (structural, per-use, same reasoning as Grid not tokenizing columns).

label.$description: Uppercase, bold, wide-tracked small caps — the column-header convention. $extensions carries textTransform:uppercase; fetch it directly (resolveToken drops $extensions), same gap handled everywhere else.

divider.$description: Hairline between rows; the last row's is dropped so it doesn't double the container's own bottom border.

hoverBg.$description: gray.50 — a quiet hover, distinct from the ghost fill.neutralHover used for pill/icon controls; a full-width table row reads better with the softer surface tint (same call ThreadListItem's own read state uses surface.dim).

selectedBg.$description: bg.primary (blue.100 tint) — the same persistent selected surface ThreadListItem and the app's state.selected already use.

state.$description: Inbox-style row emphasis pair, reused verbatim from ThreadListItem's inbox rows: an unread row leads with semibold default ink; a read row relaxes to normal-weight secondary. Purely a weight/color swap on the row's lead text, no background change (background is owned by hover/selected).
